# Write the leadership paragraph

*Acme Retail · October 2026 · generated by ddreview 1.0.0 · facts.json 3827d58e72d8*

Keep every number exactly as written. No bullet points, no new claims. Start the answer with the heading `## 📌 Executive summary` so it can be checked against that section.

| # | Finding | Who feels it | Severity | Action |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | **One in twelve card authorisations fails** on `payment-gateway` (31,398 of 348,872 in the week to 22 Oct 2026); refunds fail 45.0 %; clients request about 2.87 new tokens per business call | Shoppers and finance | red | Root-cause the `POST /pay/authorise` failures; alert on regressions; cache tokens until expiry |

| 8 | **One dependency is slow** — `legacy-erp.acme.internal` p95 3.10 s | Users and staff, depending on the caller | amber | Agree a timeout and a latency target |
